is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on the psocid Liposcelis bostrychophila, not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype insecticide-resistance markers in Anopheles mosquitoes; it performs transcriptome assembly and gene expression profiling on Liposcelis bostrychophila.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or frequencies) for insecticide resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses a laboratory stock colony of Liposcelis bostrychophila maintained in a laboratory in Chongqing, China, since 1990.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study involving transcriptome sequencing and DGE analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study does not involve field-collected mosquito populations.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study does not involve field-collected mosquito populations.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a primary transcriptome analysis of a laboratory-reared psocid colony.

supplement.evidence: The study does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This paper reports the de novo transcriptome assembly and digital gene expression (DGE) profiling of the psocid Liposcelis bostrychophila, a stored-product pest. It is not eligible because it does not study Anopheles malaria vectors or insecticide-resistance markers in those vectors.
